quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo announce clinical (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo entered into a clinical collaboration agreement with Summit Therapeutics to evaluate Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan) in combination with ivonescimab across multiple tumour types including lung and breast cancers; the companies intend to begin with a Phase III trial in 1st-line triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). The planned combination trials will be sponsored by AstraZeneca or Daiichi Sankyo; each company contributes its own medicine, all three contribute to trial costs and each retains development and commercial rights to its own medicine. Susan Galbraith (EVP, Oncology Haematology R&D): 'We believe the combination of Datroway and ivonescimab has the potential to make a meaningful difference in multiple tumour types including lung and breast cancers.' The Datroway clinical development programme has more than 20 trials, including eight Phase III trials in lung cancer, five Phase III trials in breast cancer, and one Phase III and one Phase II/III trial in urothelial cancer.
quarterly_data.figure: Phase III in 1st-line TNBC planned first; Datroway programme of more than 20 trials: eight Phase III in lung cancer, five Phase III in breast cancer, one Phase III and one Phase II/III in urothelial cancer
